post/standalone.json.why: run 1 of a net-new step must be nonzero (#38, Spec 132 x-stages.3): the TRUNCATE is the descriptor recovery.reset, then the harness re-derives every lot (440,093 lots, 23,324,929 results, about 81 min, verdict WARN on scenario_axis_cells 597). The TRUNCATE does not reset the materialize ledger gate, so without the force env run 1 gated-skipped on the empty tables (2026-10-24 19:23 retake, CHAT-127); the bracket passes the descriptor override.force_full env (Spec 132 x-captures.1, CHAT-89, CHAT-118.Q-114b) and the harness second run is a forced full recompute that must write 0 rows (the rerun-zero proof).

post/standalone.forced.json.why: #38 heal evidence (R-DP, CHAT-116 column row_sha, CHAT-118.Q-114b force env): the first 20 ungated lots by parcel_id are deleted and the step re-inserts them (records_new 20, cohort healed, post-restore matches the before-image). The materialize ledger gate would skip an unchanged run, so the --run passes the descriptor's override.force_full env RESOLVE_BYLAWS_FORCE_FULL=1; with it the bracket needs no place before the standalone (Spec 132 x-captures.1, CHAT-89), and the forced rerun-zero proof is a real full recompute that writes 0 rows (2026-10-24, 81.4 min).
